investigation: Identify the exact code/query that produced '207,600 rows' reporting

findings.delta_explanation: B2.5C classification execution (run_classification()) processed all marketplaces, adding classification data and completing the ledger. The 207,600 was the pre-classification state.

queries_tested_that_do_NOT_produce_20760: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marketplace_ledger_v1 WHERE financial_group IN (...) -> 542983
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marketplace_ledger_v1 WHERE financial_group IN (...) AND COALESCE(include_in_operational_pnl,1)=1 -> 410669
Per-marketplace counts: RIPLEY=287417, PARIS=197820, ML=109799, FALABELLA=3076
conclusion: The '207,600' figure does not exist in the current runtime. It is a historical reference from documentation that was not updated post-B2.5C. No code in the current system produces 207,600 as a ledger count.
